Keys are series-specific: verify each paper's booklet series before applying a key. 2021/2026 confirmed Series A; 2022/2024 show a '( 3 - A )' page mark; 2023/2025 need their cover page checked. All 12 papers are now ingested. CSAT keys were supplied by the user as images (2021-2025) and a PDF (2026); every key-vs-solver disagreement was re-read against the key image by hand.
